The Collection Patch is an upgrade for the Practitioner's Pouch that enhances its ability to store a wide variety of items, making it ideal for mages who need to collect and organize diverse magical components.

To apply the Collection Patch, I need to combine it with a Practitioner's Pouch in a crafting table. Once applied, the patch will permanently enhance the pouch, providing additional slots for a broader range of items.

The Collection Patch also adds a mosaic-like design to the pouch, symbolizing its ability to hold a variety of items.
